_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

mistake.en: Not knowing easy lines for a cafe

items.en: Can I have a large coffee?
items.native: A polite way to order your drink.
Ask for milk in your drink.

segments.text: Ordering coffee in English? Here are four easy lines. Repeat after me.
Can I have a large coffee?

native.caption: Nervous about ordering coffee in English? Save these 4 easy lines, such as “Can I have a large coffee?” and “Can I pay by card?” Listen to Ama, then say each one in the pause. Practice more in the Lexkite app.
